name: Oningyou Yamaa Yumashou Kudanzaka Kaiki Sousho 2
original_name: 鬼ン業　山阿誘魔性　九段坂怪奇叢書弐
source: After more than half a year since "that day," Kudanzaka Yamahiko, though bearing various scars, is gradually returning to normalcy. Prompted by the illness of his companion, Kaguro Isora, he heads north to a region steeped in kappa legends. There, he encounters another mysterious incident along with new acquaintances.
translation: 距离“那一天”已经过去半年多了，九段坂山彦虽然身上带着各种伤痕，但正在逐渐恢复正常。在同伴伊空神乐患病的推动下，他向北前往一个充满河童传说的地区。在那里，他遇到了另一起神秘事件，并结识了新朋友。
